review_prompts: Review identity and remote-access evidence.
Confirm whether jump-host activity matches approved work.
Consult the existing incident and continuity procedures.
warnings: This output is synthetic and recommendation-only.
safety_statements: No account, network, SCADA, dispatch or service action is executed.

review_prompts: Review remote-session and maintenance authorization evidence.
Review gateway and engineering-access dependencies.
Consult approved communications-continuity procedures.
warnings: Potential exposure is not confirmed compromise.
safety_statements: No polling, relay command, RTU or IED write, firewall change or substation action is executed.

review_prompts: Review source availability and planned failover context.
Compare cyber evidence with ordinary host, network and data-feed failures.
Review trusted monitoring prerequisites.
warnings: Missing cyber telemetry does not establish physical grid state.
safety_statements: No failover, service restart or operational-control action is executed.

review_prompts: Request accountable protection-engineering review.
Review configuration provenance and approved-work evidence.
Review known-good settings evidence using existing procedures.
warnings: Protected-boundary adjacency does not prove relay compromise or unavailability.
safety_statements: No relay interrogation, settings change, trip, block or firmware action is executed.

review_prompts: Review clean-source and recovery-plan evidence.
Review visibility, identity and communications prerequisites.
Confirm that accountable continuity personnel approve any later recovery work.
warnings: The readiness score does not certify a clean backup or safe restoration.
safety_statements: No restore, failover, configuration deployment or service activation is executed.

review_prompts: Review vendor and remote-access authorization evidence.
Review industrial-DMZ dependencies and session evidence.
Consult the approved site incident procedures.
warnings: This output is synthetic and recommendation-only.
safety_statements: No session termination, account change, firewall change, host isolation or DCS action is executed.

review_prompts: Request accountable control-engineering review.
Review project provenance and maintenance authorization.
Review known-good configuration evidence.
warnings: Support-asset exposure does not prove controller compromise.
safety_statements: No controller query or write, project transfer, HMI or DCS restart, logic change or process action is executed.

review_prompts: Review source-system, campaign and maintenance context.
Compare cyber evidence with data, laboratory and communications failures.
Review trusted historian, batch and quality prerequisites.
warnings: Cyber evidence does not determine product quality or physical process state.
safety_statements: No batch, release, loading or process decision is executed.

review_prompts: Request accountable cyber, operations and process-safety review.
Review independent safety-status evidence using approved plant procedures.
Review authorized safety-work and proof-test context.
warnings: The dashboard cannot make a safe or unsafe plant determination.
safety_statements: No SIS or ESD query, bypass, reset, logic transfer, alarm change or safety action is executed.

review_prompts: Review clean-source, configuration-provenance and startup-procedure evidence.
Review recovery prerequisites with accountable cyber, operations, control, quality and process-safety personnel.
Confirm independent plant authorization before any later startup work.
warnings: The dashboard does not declare the plant ready or safe to start.
safety_statements: No restore, startup, failover, project transfer, quality release or loading action is executed.
